Questions or a tour?

020 – 423 39 30 info@huizefrankendael.nl

Huize Frankendael caters for business events of 2 to 300 people. The 18th-century salons and 19th-century rooms in the house provide a stately backdrop for a private dinner, training session, network event or meeting. The coach house is another inspirational setting for workshops and off-site days. In good weather, the formal garden offers a relaxed environment for breaks and break-out sessions.

Tailor-made

We are on hand to discuss your needs personally, and our team makes sure you feel at home. All rooms have free wifi; projectors, screens and flip charts can be set up on request. The proximity of the A10 ring road and ample parking (exit tickets for the nearby car park available) make this a practical venue for business guests.

Slow Food gastronomy

Restaurant Merkelbach (opens in a new tab) serves high-quality breakfast, lunch, drinks or dinner in every room, according to the kitchen’s Slow Food philosophy.
